html: Asthma is a long-term condition in which the airways become swollen and narrow, making it harder to breathe. Symptoms can be mild or severe and often come in flare-ups.

image.alt: Illustration of a pair of lungs
image.caption: An asthma action plan explains what to do on good days and during flare-ups.
image.title: Illustration of a pair of lungs

html:
• Colds and other respiratory infections
  • Pollen, dust, mold and pet dander
  • Smoke and air pollution
  • Exercise or cold air

• Work with your care team on an asthma action plan
  • Use controller and rescue medicines as directed
  • Know and avoid your triggers
Call 911 if breathing is very difficult, lips or fingernails look bluish, or a rescue inhaler is not helping.
